notes:
v0.6.38: document the ReticulumHF wizard as the fix for freedvtnc2 audio.

Operator's note (2026-09-09 15:42 MDT): the launcher page
should tell users to use the ReticulumHF button to set up
freedvtnc2 audio, not hand-edit /etc/reticulumhf/config.env.
The wizard correctly maps ALSA card N to freedvtnc2's
PortAudio device ID; hand-editing is wrong because the
two number spaces don't match.

Documented in two places:
- README.md: added a TL;DR block under "Operating a
  deployed box" that points to the wizard and explains
  why hand-editing is wrong.
- g90-image/QUICK-START.md: added a ReticulumHF entry to
  the "What the buttons do" list, updated the first-time
  setup steps to mention port 8080, and updated the Web
  UIs list at the bottom to reflect the new port layout
  (launcher :80, wizard :8080, not the old :8090).

The QUICK-START.md is the document the operator hands to
a new box owner; this change makes the right fix path
discoverable from the first read.
